summary: Cleveland Rock or Snow Peak lookout, Linn County: cabin 1923, rebuilt 1965, dismantled April 1980. No source describes the summit today.

facts.design: Summit cabin; the 1965 rebuild is called an L-4 cab (register) or a 14 by 14 ft building (district report)
facts.status_note: Lookout dismantled in April 1980; no source describes what remains.

visit.trail_note: Wikipedia lists a trail as the easiest route; road access to the summit is primitive

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says removed in 1980 and firelookout.com says destroyed. The Oregon lookout history and Wikipedia say dismantled after neglect and vandalism. The story uses dismantled.

The register calls the 1965 structure an L-4 cab that may have been modified during construction; the district report gives a 14 by 14 foot building. Both describe the 1965 rebuild; the story gives the report's size and mentions the register's label.

sources.title: Snow Peak (Thomas Cairn) Fire Lookout Cabin

notes_for_editor: Name: the register title says Thomas Cairn, but none of the pages read explain that name; the early sources call the site Cleveland Rock. Agency: the register says administered by Linn FPA while Wikipedia places the summit in Willamette National Forest; not reconciled. The register's 1965 'L-4 cab' label and the district's 14 by 14 ft building are both reported. No source describes the summit today. The record's 'ground' kind fits a cabin on the rock.
